title: Purge retired vendor/reqwest and vendor/fluent-uri patch trees and enforce zero unused Cargo patches
goal: Remove the 28,435-line (`1.05 MiB`, 73-file) retired `vendor/reqwest` and `vendor/fluent-uri` patch trees, `[workspace.dependencies] reqwest`, and `[[patch.unused]]` lockfile entries left unused after `T-CLAUDENOA2ASDK-1` and the std JSON-schema cut, eliminating unused-patch Cargo warnings and pinning zero `[[patch.unused]]` entries in `tests/architecture_tests.rs`.
limitations: `reqwest` and `fluent-uri` were already outside the active compile graph (`[[patch.unused]]`), so host compile unit count is unchanged while repository source bloat drops by 28,435 lines.
Windows x86_64 release qualification remains owed on a native Windows host.
